source.filingText: FORM 12b-25 NOTIFICATION OF LATE FILING (Check One) x Form 10-K o Form 20-F o Form 11-K o Form 10-Q For Period Ended: December 31, 2024 PART I - REGISTRANT INFORMATION Moatable, Inc. Former Name if Applicable Renren Inc. PART II - RULES 12B-25(b) AND (c) x (a) The reason described in reasonable detail in Part III of this form could not be eliminated without unreasonable effort or expense; x (b) The subject annual report on Form 10-K will be filed on or before the fifteenth calendar day following the prescribed due date; and x (c) The accountant's statement or other exhibit required by Rule 12b-25(c) has been attached if applicable PART III - NARRATIVE Moatable, Inc. was unable to file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the period ended December 31, 2024 on a timely basis because the Company was unable, without unreasonable effort or expense, to complete its financial data within the prescribed period. During preparation of the financial statements, it was identified that sales tax liability was understated by $3.651 million. The Company determined that previously issued financial statements included in the annual report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2023 and quarterly reports on Form 10-Q for periods in 2023 and 2024 should no longer be relied upon and will need to be restated to correct these errors. The Company anticipates that it will file the Form 10-K no later than the fifteenth calendar day following the prescribed filing date. PART IV - OTHER INFORMATION (1) Scott Stone +1 632-473-5749 (2) Have all other periodic reports required under Section 13 or 15(d) been filed? Yes x No o (3) Is it anticipated that any significant change in results of operations from the corresponding period for the last fiscal year will be reflected by the earnings statements to be included in the subject report or portion thereof? Yes x No o The Company anticipates an increase in revenues of around 22% and a significant decrease in net loss of around 84%. Based on currently available information, the Company expects to report three material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting. Date: March 31, 2025 By: /s/ Scott Stone
